shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
repeated row of similar elements along the top
human or humanoid figure with arms
justification: Both are low-relief carvings organized into horizontal bands with a repeated row of similar forms across the upper zone and profile figures below, but that is about as generic as relief conventions get. A shows isolated animals (quadruped, birds, a snake-like descending form) with no interaction and no setting, whereas B shows a narrative military scene of armed human figures on a wheeled siege engine assaulting a walled and towered building, an entirely different subject with figure-to-architecture relationships absent in A.
